A channel is where notifications go: a T: A channel is where notifications go: a Telegram chat, a webhook, a mail address, a Matrix room. Its token or password is encrypted and never shown again.
A check looks at the hosts of a group of: A check looks at the hosts of a group of an inventory at regular intervals: disk space, memory, services, certificates. Ansible does it over the connection the inventory gives, with nothing to install on the hosts.
A check of your own: a playbook of a pro: A check of your own: a playbook of a project whose last task, lineadicomando.fleet.fleet_result, gives a state, a summary and metrics for each host.
A credential holds what a run needs to l: A credential holds what a run needs to log in to the nodes, to open an Ansible Vault or to fetch a git repository. Secrets are encrypted and can never be read back.
A host pattern; \"all\" for every host o: A host pattern; "all" for every host of the inventory.
A job template puts together a playbook,: A job template puts together a playbook, an inventory and the credentials to run it. Once defined, it is launched with one click.
A JSON object. Not for secrets: they wou: A JSON object. Not for secrets: they would be stored in clear.
A playbook of a project that describes h: A playbook of a project that describes how the hosts should be, run in check mode: a host on which a task would change something has drifted. The differences are kept, for operators.
A problem is confirmed, and told about,: A problem is confirmed, and told about, once it has been seen that many times in a row; until then it is checked again more often. Checks run on the minute, so shorter times are rounded up to it.
A problem is told once it is confirmed,: A problem is told once it is confirmed, after the attempts its check asks for. A reminder comes while nobody has acknowledged it.
A project is where playbooks, roles and: A project is where playbooks, roles and inventory files come from: a git repository, a directory of this server, files written here or an uploaded archive.
A rule says what to tell about, and thro: A rule says what to tell about, and through which channel: for example, every failed run, the runs of one schedule with changes, or the problems of the checks of a group of hosts.
A run with changes is also successful: c: A run with changes is also successful: choose both and it is told once, as with changes.
A schedule launches a job template at th: A schedule launches a job template at the times of a calendar: every night, every quarter of an hour, on the first of the month. Its runs go through the same queue as the others.
A tar archive, compressed or not, or a z: A tar archive, compressed or not, or a zip, of at most {{size}} MB.
A test message is on its way to {{name}}: A test message is on its way to {{name}}: see how it went below.
